{{Quote|I once belonged to an expert in butterflies, and the Aargauuns have assembled the most remarkable collection!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Banking">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030807aargau|text=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs|int=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs}}</ref>}}
The '''Aargauuns''' were a group from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]]. The [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Talia Moonseeker]] was Aargauun, and shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Moonseeker reached the rank of Jedi Knight after [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Va'too]]. Four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after her promotion, Moonseeker fought in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], during which her former Master was [[Death/Legends|killed]], while the Aargauun survived; the outcome compelled Moonseeker to hang her head in shame.<ref name="WS">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'' by [[Karen Miller]], Talia Moonseeker's species name was misspelled as "Argauun." Miller confirmed the mistake and that she was referencing the obscure people, not creating a new one.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:KMillerEmail2.png|creator=[[Karen Miller]]|date=2012-06-29}}</ref>
